label.v: Clean workspace of any previous release artifacts

args.v:
# j2gha-local: was `make -j4 --output-sync=target dist` (needs Erlang, rebar, Elixir and Sphinx). Builds a
          # stand-in release tarball named as the real dist target names it from version.mk (the tarball-build form,
          # without the git sha suffix, so both sides archive the same name). Its configure and Makefile stand in for
          # CouchDB's: the Test and Package stage runs its configure/make/junit/package commands against them unchanged.
          . ./version.mk
          rel="apache-couchdb-${vsn_major}.${vsn_minor}.${vsn_patch}"
          rm -rf "$rel" && mkdir -p "$rel"
          cp LICENSE NOTICE version.mk "$rel/"
          printf '%s
' '#!/bin/sh' 'echo "configure (j2gha-local stand-in): $*"' > "$rel/configure"
          chmod +x "$rel/configure"
          printf '%s
' "<testsuite name='couch_tests' tests='2' failures='0' errors='0'>"             "<testcase classname='couch_tests' name='basic'/>" "<testcase classname='couch_tests' name='config'/>"             '</testsuite>' > "$rel/eunit-report.xml"
          printf '%s
' '.RECIPEPREFIX := >'             'all xref elixir elixir-search mango-test weatherreport-test nouveau-test quickjs-test262 build-report:'             '>@echo "make $@ (j2gha-local stand-in)"'             'eunit:'             '>mkdir -p .eunit && cp eunit-report.xml .eunit/couch_tests.xml' > "$rel/Makefile"
          tar czf "$rel.tar.gz" "$rel" && rm -rf "$rel"
          echo "Done: $rel.tar.gz"
